# KumoRoute

> KumoRoute is a lightweight, local-first desktop client for the mihomo proxy core,
> for Windows, Linux and macOS. It coordinates system proxy and Windows VPN with real
> connectivity verification and rollback, scores node quality (latency, success rate,
> jitter), measures DNS/IPv6 leaks, and updates itself safely (SHA256, in-place,
> rollback). MIT licensed client; bundled mihomo core is GPL-3.0.

Key facts:
- No account, no telemetry, no ads. Settings, subscriptions, logs and stats stay local (%APPDATA%\KumoRoute on Windows).
- KumoRoute is a client only: it does not provide or sell proxy nodes or subscriptions.
- Languages in the app: Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English.
- Current version: 0.8.1.
